name: en-prompt
description: Translates non-English user prompts to English before they reach the LLM, for token optimization and better results. Uses a UserPromptSubmit hook with a pluggable translation engine (local Ollama by default). Runs entirely via a Python 3 stdlib script — no pip dependencies.
